Nearby, a notice board commands attention, its posted papers listing new taxes, curfew rules, and a stark warning about a missing patrol. A well-appointed townhouse presides over the square in quiet contrast to the clamoring crowd. Off to one side, a figure in threadbare clothes remains almost motionless, their gaze flicking uneasily to faces and packs more than the gate itself. Amidst the murmurs, a tavern runner nearby pitches hot stew and fresh rumors, his voice cutting through the damp air, promising news for a coin. The weight of official watchfulness and uncertain rumors hang in the moisture-heavy air as you stand at the fringe of this gathering.
